gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-hoover: Spacious gaps open up the curve ends of Stencilia. Hoover brings a generous entry into the e's eye and compressed ascenders, a refined, robust counterweight to that striking display face.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-alpino: Alpino looks tall and cozy, its ascenders short, while True North stands stocky with curves that refuse to close. Paragraphs set in that sans would feel loose, casual and unhurried.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-familjen-grotes: Contemporary and stocky, True North is all tall middle band. Where True North excels at stocky, curve-open impact, Familjen Grotesk excels at lively, plain-spoken text with bowls left open on one side.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-hoover: True North stands stocky with a tall middle band and curves that refuse to close, set against Hoover, a refined serif. Muscle up top, polish below; that tension is the draw.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-ranade: Stocky meets spread-out: True North packs a tall middle band while Ranade lets its stroke ends drift far apart. That sans would read loose and organic, its weight shifting only slightly.
gen-dafont-upheaval-fs-merriweather-sans: Upheaval closes its letterforms into a tight, authoritative grip. Merriweather Sans opens its e clearly to the right and stands sturdy and tall, giving that tension somewhere to breathe.
gen-dafont-vcr-osd-mono-switzer: Lo-fi and retro-tech, VCR OSD Mono towers with fixed-width, code-style letters. Where VCR OSD Mono excels at that unvarying, towering look, Switzer, a plain sans, excels at approachable, wire-like Swiss clarity.
gen-dafont-verve-fs-bespoke-slab: Verve excels at bowls that nearly seal shut, with hair-thin joins in between. And Bespoke Slab is best at grounded, refined serif solidity, with tall bodies in every lowercase letter.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, its ascenders looking short. Visitor, nostalgic and digital with gaping mouths on its e, leads while the plain sans keeps its curve endings well apart.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Gaping e mouths and short ascenders: that is Visitor. Visitor does best at nostalgic, digital punch, while Noto Sans Lisu does best at professional, neutral text with wide-open s curves.
